title: Rabbits in Forest
summary: Given an array of answers from rabbits about how many other rabbits share their color, determine the minimum number of rabbits in the forest.
statement: Given an array of answers from rabbits about how many other rabbits share their color, determine the minimum number of rabbits in the forest.
constraints: 0 <= len(answers) <= 1,000; each answer is between 0 and 999.
An answer x describes x other same-color rabbits; return the minimum possible total.
hints: Rabbits reporting x fit in color groups of exactly x+1.
Group equal answers into as few ceiling-sized batches as possible.
For count c and group g=x+1, add ceil(c/g)*g.
Each batch needs a distinct color; filling batches maximally minimizes unseen rabbits.
editorial: Each batch needs a distinct color; filling batches maximally minimizes unseen rabbits.

tests.explanation: Two answer-one rabbits share a group of two; answer two requires a group of three, totaling five.
All three may belong to one color group of eleven rabbits.
